lines.1: Ms. Inori fixes me with a piercing glare.
lines.3: The air feels as though I have seen something I was never meant to see.
lines.4: 「...It is already time for students to leave.」
lines.5: There is an unmistakable menace in her voice too.
lines.7: 「I came to bring you the key.」
lines.9: Ms. Inori stands and approaches me.
lines.10: For some reason, my familiar homeroom teacher feels intimidating.
lines.12: 「Teacher may be in the classroom. Come on, Mana. Stop moping and walk properly.」
lines.13: My classmates' voices drift in from the hall.
lines.14: 「Yes, indeed. I have the key, Tsushima.」
lines.17: She is back to her usual airy self.
lines.18: The tension drains from the classroom all at once.
lines.19: ...It feels as if I had been dreaming.
